quests.title: Mutual Exchange

dialogue.t: Mimi ika yaya nye! Mimi tomo, mimi mani ye.
Mani. Mi muhe mani. Unu du mani! Hahahahaha.
This one just told a joke in Hilichurlian, then laughed at its own joke. They must have such a spiritually impoverished existence... Poor things.
Mi muhe <color=#00E1FFFF>kucha gusha</color>. Kucha gusha dada. Unu gusha dada!
He wants to... Actually, never mind, you can find everything you need to know inside the handbook.
Hahahaha, kucha gusha unu gusha. Unu kucha si!
Wei? Odomu tomo zido mi! <color=#00E1FFFF>Mosi aba nunu</color>!
<color=#00E1FFFF>Mosi aba nunu</color>... Does the handbook say what that phrase means?
Nye nye nye. Kucha, gusha. Hahahaha. Kucha gusha, kucha, gusha. Hahaha.

quests.description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship…?
